criteria: Dual-suite sdd_sdlc_catalog_baseline and sdd_sdlc_catalog_target registered in root Cargo.toml (harness/implement, not BaselineAuthor) at tests/sdd/sdlc_catalog.baseline.rs and sdlc_catalog.target.rs.
After implement: target GREEN, baseline still GREEN; cargo test --workspace --features demo, fmt --check, and clippy -D warnings stay green.
Twenty-six control.source|cicd|release|supply-chain.* controls with stable ids, domains, evidence, tests, and honest automation; count stays 20–30; control.source.protected-branch remains.
Evidence types in spec §4.4 are facts not conclusions; IDs are provider-neutral (evidence.repository.* etc., not evidence.github.*).
Tests include the nine Prompt-05 example ids and evaluate populations (all non-archived in-scope default branches protected), not existence of one envelope.
Evaluator outcomes distinguish missing, stale, failure, manual review, and approved exception on the seven named fixtures; missing scan evidence is not a technical failure.
Release authorization, authority-separation, security-review, and secure-development-policy are Hybrid or Manual and cannot auto-pass without attestation.
Catalog validator accepts the SDLC slice: no duplicate/orphan/dangling ids, no provider names, no ISO/SOC2/NIS2 references in canonical SDLC content.
ISO pack control ids and mappings are unchanged; sdd_iso27001_assurance_target remains green.
GitHub collector is not expanded; SDLC catalog tests do not couple to GITHUB_EVIDENCE_TYPES or scanner internals.
No second CanonicalCatalog loader, no second EvidenceValue, no resolve_repository_inventory / SdlcPopulation fork; Prompt 03 coverage is consumed as-is.
Approved-exception fixture uses existing Exception IR; expired/revoked exceptions do not pass.
IAM family and catalog-infrastructure fixture IDs remain; sdd_iam_catalog_target and sdd_canonical_assurance_catalog_target stay green.
Prompt 01 SSOT docs/sdd/canonical-assurance-catalog-v1.md and Prompt 04 IAM SSOT are not overwritten.
A GitLab or Bitbucket collector could populate the same evidence contracts without catalog changes (no GitHub-native object names in canonical IDs).
CanonicalCatalog::validate and workspace checks pass with the SDLC files listed in manifest.toml.
